commands.title: Generate Words

commands.name: generate-text
commands.title: Generate Placeholder Text

preferences.name: defaultLang
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language used by quick Generate Paragraphs/Sentences/Words commands.

preferences.name: defaultTheme
preferences.title: Theme
preferences.description: Domain theme used by quick commands (ignored for Latin).

preferences.name: grammarCorrect
preferences.title: Grammar Correct
preferences.description: Whether quick commands should generate grammatically correct text.

preferences.name: orthographyCorrect
preferences.title: Orthography Correct
preferences.description: Whether quick commands should generate orthographically correct text.
preferences.label: Generate orthographically correct text (uncheck to inject spelling noise)

preferences.name: quickAction
preferences.title: Quick Command Action
preferences.description: Action performed after Generate Paragraphs/Sentences/Words finishes.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the Prolixo API (defaults to the online production API).
